items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: As a matter of fact, when we did Groove Me by King Floyd, Floyd wasn't there.

ctx.x: So Groove Me by King Floyd?

That was the same thing. As a matter of fact, when we did Groove Me by King Floyd, Floyd wasn't there. And they didn't even know if I was gonna, if I, that's what I was saying about producers before. The producer had one song, I think that was the song on the back of Groove Me, whatever that was. It's only, it was one of the songs that was a hit after Groove Me. And the producer told me, he said, listen man, do any songs on all of these tunes that's on the tape but, you have to do this certain tune that I want.…
You're thinking of bass, drums, horns, everything. I'm thinking about everything. So you're saying when you cut that, King Floyd wasn't even around?
